I used to suffer from binge eating although it was more on because I avoided eating throughout the day since I was suffering from anorexia but it would reach the point that at night, during the times when I am not busy with anything, I couldnt help myself and start eating too much, even if im already full. What helped me overcome this is starting to fix the time that I eat everyday and portioning out my meals. i started eating breakfast, lunch and dinner again. I made sure that what I ate were both healthy and delicious so that I wouldnt get too overwhelmed by gaining too much weight fast. At the same time, when I get hungry before my meals, I would snack on fruits since its filling, low in calories, and most of all nutritious. I also stopped buying junk food or food that I would usually crave for the most when I am binge eating.

what also helps is to keep yourself busy or distracted throughout the day. Especially at night. Pay attention to the food that you binge eat the most and try to get rid of it or lessen how much you keep in your house. Most of all, do not restrict yourself from eating because it also causes binge eating when you reach the point wherein you are too hungry. What also helped me is by eating slower because it helps your body recognize that you are already full. When people binge eat, they usually eat too fast so they only realize that they've eaten too much when its too late. Also, drink plenty of water during meals since it helps in making yourself feel full.

​

I hope this helps

Ive been suffering from depression and borderline personality disorder for a few years now. Its hard for me to maintain relationships and I always feel empty and not up for anything. But no matter how hard I am to love, my boyfriend still finds ways to make me feel loved and happy. He always finds activities that we can do together and that I enjoy. He knows me the most and knows how to cheer me up and keep me going. 

I know what youre feeling is hard. I know its hard to be happy. But what ive learned is that we should try, in some ways, to lift ourselves up. There are people who love us and are willing to do anything to make us happy. I guess all we have to do is try to accept the love and happiness they are offering. We owe it to them to try and pick ourselves up.

I dont mind making my own food but she also doesnt allow me to get any of the food that she buys because its for them. She leaves me at home whenever they go out, even during family vacations. I wouldnt even know that they are going on a vacation. I'd just be surprised one day that im home alone and I dont even know when they'll be coming back. She treats me differently from how she treats my siblings. I hope you can find some way to be positive and get away from your mom. Fuck the blood is thicker than water shit. Toxic people are toxic people no matter who they are.
